knowledge:
- key_parameters: i=specifies the assay name in the SummarizedExperiment object to be used as input (e.g., "raw", "knn", "knn_vsn") ;; group=factor or column name indicating sample groups for filtering, imputation, plotting, or comparison ;; cut=threshold for feature filtering (e.g., proportion of non-missing values) ;; method=algorithm to use (e.g., "knn", "rf", "bpca" for imputation; "vsn", "pqn", "loess" for normalization; "pca", "plsda", "tsne" for dimension reduction) ;; rtime_var=rowData column name containing retention times for feature clustering ;; rt_cut=retention time difference threshold for clustering ;; cor_cut=correlation threshold for feature clustering ;; cor_grouping=method for correlation-based grouping (e.g., "connected", "louvain")
- alternatives: MsCoreUtils for alternative imputation and normalization methods ;; MsFeatures (e.g., groupClosest, groupConsecutive, groupSimilarityMatrix) for alternative retention time and similarity grouping algorithms ;; QFeatures for aggregating feature intensities to deal with redundancy ;; InterpretMSSpectrum for adduct annotation ;; limma user's guide for more complex model specifications (interaction, multi-level models)
- when_to_use: When analyzing quantitative metabolomics data (e.g., LC/MS peak intensities) stored in a SummarizedExperiment object, requiring preprocessing (filtering, imputation, normalization), visualization, feature clustering, and statistical comparison.
- pitfalls: kNN imputation typically requires scaling to avoid variance-based weighting, though Gower distance in qmtools allows original scales ;; compareSamples expects log-transformed feature intensities (e.g., after VSN or log transformation) ;; reduceFeatures with PLS-DA requires group information (y).

workflows.name: metabolomics_preprocessing_and_analysis
workflows.intent: Preprocess quantitative metabolomics data (filtering, imputation, normalization), cluster redundant features, and perform differential abundance analysis.
input: faahko_se.RData (SummarizedExperiment object containing raw metabolomics peak intensities, rowData with retention times, and colData with sample groups)
workflows.stages: 1. Feature filtering based on missing values (removeFeatures) ;; 2. Missing value visualization (plotMiss) and imputation (imputeIntensity) ;; 3. Intensity normalization (normalizeIntensity) and visualization (plotBox) ;; 4. Dimension reduction (reduceFeatures) and visualization (plotReduced) ;; 5. Feature clustering based on retention time and intensity correlation (clusterFeatures, plotRTgroup) ;; 6. Differential abundance analysis between sample groups (compareSamples)
workflows.code:
library(qmtools)
library(SummarizedExperiment)
library(vsn)
library(pls)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
set.seed(1e8)

data(faahko_se)

## Only keep the first assay for the vignette
assays(faahko_se)[2:4] <- NULL
faahko_se

dim(removeFeatures(faahko_se, i = "raw",
                   group = colData(faahko_se)$sample_group,
                   cut = 0.80))

g <- factor(colData(faahko_se)$sample_group, levels = c("WT", "KO"))

plotMiss(faahko_se, i = "raw", group = g)

se <- imputeIntensity(faahko_se, i = "raw", name = "knn", method = "knn")

se <- normalizeIntensity(se, i = "knn", name = "knn_vsn", method = "vsn")

p1 <- plotBox(se, i = "knn", group = g, log2 = TRUE)
p2 <- plotBox(se, i = "knn_vsn", group = g)
p1 + p2 + plot_annotation(title = "Before vs After normalization")

m_pca <- reduceFeatures(se, i = "knn_vsn", method = "pca", ncomp = 2)
summary(m_pca)

m_plsda <- reduceFeatures(se, i = "knn_vsn", method = "plsda", ncomp = 2, y = g)
summary(m_plsda)

p_pca <- plotReduced(m_pca, group = g)
p_plsda <- plotReduced(m_plsda, label = TRUE, ellipse = TRUE)
p_pca + p_plsda + plot_annotation(title = "PCA and PLS-DA")

se <- clusterFeatures(se, i = "knn_vsn", rtime_var = "rtmed",
                      rt_cut = 10, cor_cut = 0.7)
rowData(se)[, c("rtmed", "rtime_group", "feature_group")]

se_connected <- clusterFeatures(se, i = "knn_vsn", rtime_var = "rtmed",
                                rt_cut = 10, cor_cut = 0.7,
                                cor_grouping = "connected")
plotRTgroup(se_connected, i = "knn_vsn", group = "FG.22")

se_louvain <- clusterFeatures(se, i = "knn_vsn", rtime_var = "rtmed",
                              rt_cut = 10, cor_cut = 0.7,
                              cor_grouping = "louvain")
plotRTgroup(se_louvain, i = "knn_vsn", group = "FG.22")

plotRTgroup(se_louvain, i = "knn_vsn", group = "FG.22", type = "pairs")

fit <- compareSamples(se, i = "knn_vsn", group = "sample_group",
                      class1 = "WT", class2 = "KO")
head(fit, 5)

colData(se)$covar <- c(rep(c("A", "B"), 6))
compareSamples(se, i = "knn_vsn", group = "sample_group",
               covariates = "covar", class1 = "WT", class2 = "KO",
               number = 5)
